description: Keep the room on time. Click the stopwatch in the rail and a timer lands on the board, ticking on every screen, even for people without Timer. Pick 1, 3, 5, 10, 15 or 25 minutes, add a label and press Start on the timer itself. Pause, add a minute or reset from its buttons, the panel or the right-click menu, and hear a soft chime or a bell at the end. Made for workshops, retros, critiques and focus sprints.
